method: 3 fresh processes per variant/input in alternating order; CPU time and peak RSS from /usr/bin/time -lp; compressed frames decode to exactly the raw bytes
memory_scope: Complete compression plus round-trip verification process, with compressor context retained during verification. This is not runtime memory or a direct production-packer RSS measurement.
limitations: Two Darwin ARM64 inputs. No clear CPU-speedup claim. Versus the untuned level-22 control, SWC is 143 bytes smaller and Rspack is 380 bytes larger.
